# Lee Sagi Photography

> Photographs by Lee Sagi. Based in the East Bay, California. Shoots on a Nikon D7500. Mostly black and white, street.

I photograph what I run into. Backcountry tracks and desert camps, the streets near home, people I know, and more. No rime or reason, just photos I like.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/btbw666/
Threads: https://www.threads.com/@btbw666
Contact: lee.sagi.photography@gmail.com

## Collections

- [The Streets](https://leesagi.com/albums/the-streets/): 31 photographs
- [Faces](https://leesagi.com/albums/faces/): 18 photographs
- [Ghost](https://leesagi.com/albums/ghost/): 5 photographs
- [Birds](https://leesagi.com/albums/birds/): 5 photographs
- [Land & Sky](https://leesagi.com/albums/land-and-sky/): 16 photographs
- [Odds and Ends](https://leesagi.com/albums/misc/): 7 photographs

## Outings

- [Alameda - Park Street, Webster Street and the Hornet](https://leesagi.com/outings/alameda-park-webster-and-the-hornet/) (2026-11-16): My first outing with the Nikon Z5 II: a waterfront trail, Park Street and Webster Street after the rain, then the pier where the USS Hornet is docked, under a storm sky.
- [Hayward Jewels and Potential Jewels](https://leesagi.com/outings/hayward-jewels-and-potential-jewels/) (2026-11-11): Veterans Day in Hayward: a well-kept cemetery, the Japanese Gardens full of dads and little kids, and a quiet holiday downtown that's a little worn around the edges.
- [Downtown Hayward - A Morning Walk](https://leesagi.com/outings/hayward-downtown-morning-walk/) (2026-11-04): A good-mood Wednesday morning around City Hall and B Street: landmarks, storefronts, people out early, and a man steam-cleaning the sidewalk who wanted to see the photos.
- [Pleasanton Main Street Before Opening](https://leesagi.com/outings/pleasanton-main-street-before-opening/) (2026-10-30): A Friday morning on Main Street before the stores opened: a half-empty, slightly eerie downtown, and an hour of sitting by crosswalks waiting for people to walk into the frame.
- [Oakland Chinatown - Murals, Vendors and the Produce Market](https://leesagi.com/outings/oakland-chinatown-murals-vendors-produce-market/) (2026-10-26): My first morning in Oakland Chinatown, chasing the feel of New York's Chinatown without driving into San Francisco. Shot mostly from the car, in hard morning sun.
- [Downtown San Mateo - A Gray Morning Walk](https://leesagi.com/outings/downtown-san-mateo-gray-morning/) (2026-10-21): An overcast Wednesday morning in downtown San Mateo with the 35mm: a city just waking up, a walk documenting what I saw, and 20 minutes on a planter by a crosswalk.
